column1: 2.3.1.3 MB2-Transmitter Unit. This unit works on spatial power combination technique.
The RF signal radiated from n number of elements of linear array is combined in the space
and forms the beam perpendicular to the wave front. The beam can be steered in the space
by controlling the phase of the RF signal applied to the elements of the linear array. Multi
beam transmitter employs Rotman Lens fed Linear Array concept to produce fixed
contiguous beams in the coverage angle of the array.
